race.description: Coolgardie Tyre Services Coolgardie Cup Hcp
race.comment: The feature of the day now and LILLIAN (7) ran over the top to score two back at Belmont before a 2L defeat last time out when on the quick back-up. Now out in trip slightly which should suit her better and she rates highly on her recent form. May get back in the run but she can round them up. OPPORTUNISTIC (9) creates interest as he lands here first-up. He was solid in his only trial coming in and he showed signs of life last campaign despite not winning. Pike sticks with him from the latest trial and with the aid of an inside alley, she can score on resumption. THE JESTER'S SON (11) finished off nicely to bolt in here last start from well back in the run. He's unbeaten at this track and trip and he drops a stack of weight for today's assignment. Can go back-to-back. GINGER BAKER (1) is better suited here and can improve quickly out in trip. OUTSPOKEN LAD (10) is building nicely and won't be far away.
